dz: 重建时代:美国内战后对密西西比州的军事控制结束,重新被接纳入盟.
de: Reconstruction Era: Post-U.S. Civil War military control of Mississippi ends and it is readmitted to the Union.

de: President-elect Abraham Lincoln arrives secretly in Washington, D.C., after the thwarting of an alleged assassination plot in Baltimore, Maryland.

t: 南非奥兰治自由邦正式独立。
te: The official independence of the Orange Free State, South Africa is declared.
dz: 南非奥兰治自由邦正式独立。
de: The official independence of the Orange Free State, South Africa is declared.

t: 布埃纳·维斯塔战役:在墨西哥,未来总统扎卡里·泰勒将军手下的美国军队击败了墨西哥将军安东尼奥·…
te: Battle of Buena Vista: In Mexico, American troops under future president General Zachary Taylor defeat Mexican General …
dz: 墨西哥-美国战争:布埃纳·维斯塔战役:在墨西哥,未来总统扎卡里·泰勒将军手下的美国军队击败了墨西哥将军安东尼奥·洛佩斯·德·圣安娜.
de: Mexican–American War: Battle of Buena Vista: In Mexico, American troops under future president General Zachary Taylor defeat Mexican General Antonio López de Santa Anna.

t: 阿拉莫人的围攻(阿拉莫战役前作)始于德克萨斯州的圣安东尼奥.
te: The Siege of the Alamo (prelude to the Battle of the Alamo) begins in San Antonio, Texas.
dz: 德克萨斯革命:阿拉莫人的围攻(阿拉莫战役前作)始于德克萨斯州的圣安东尼奥.
de: Texas Revolution: The Siege of the Alamo (prelude to the Battle of the Alamo) begins in San Antonio, Texas.

t: 一个谋杀所有英国内阁部长的阴谋被曝光,阴谋者被捕.
te: A plot to murder all the British cabinet ministers is exposed and the conspirators arrested.
dz: 卡托街阴谋:一个谋杀所有英国内阁部长的阴谋被曝光,阴谋者被捕.
de: Cato Street Conspiracy: A plot to murder all the British cabinet ministers is exposed and the conspirators arrested.

t: 冯·斯托本男爵抵达宾夕法尼亚州福吉谷，帮助训练大陆军。
te: Baron von Steuben arrives at Valley Forge, Pennsylvania, to help train the Continental Army.
dz: 美国独立战争：冯·斯托本男爵抵达宾夕法尼亚州福吉谷，帮助训练大陆军。
de: American Revolutionary War: Baron von Steuben arrives at Valley Forge, Pennsylvania, to help train the Continental Army.

t: 圭亚那伯比斯奴隶起义:南美第一次大奴隶起义.
te: The first major slave revolt in South America.
dz: 圭亚那伯比斯奴隶起义:南美第一次大奴隶起义.
de: Berbice slave uprising in Guyana: The first major slave revolt in South America.

t: J·S·巴赫带领他的"塔菲尔-音乐"(Tafel-Music Shepherd Cantata…
te: J. S. Bach leads his Tafel-Music Shepherd Cantata for the birthday of Christian, Duke of Saxe-Weissenfels.
dz: J·S·巴赫带领他的"塔菲尔-音乐"(Tafel-Music Shepherd Cantata)为萨克森-魏森费尔斯公爵克里斯蒂安的生日献礼.
de: J. S. Bach leads his Tafel-Music Shepherd Cantata for the birthday of Christian, Duke of Saxe-Weissenfels.

t: 传统上是"古腾堡圣经"的出版日期,是第一本用可移动类型印刷的西方书籍.
te: Traditionally the date of publication of the Gutenberg Bible, the first Western book printed with movable type.
dz: 传统上是"古腾堡圣经"的出版日期,是第一本用可移动类型印刷的西方书籍.
de: Traditionally the date of publication of the Gutenberg Bible, the first Western book printed with movable type.

t: 后吴泽甸废除了王位,恢复了唐朝.
te: Empress Wu Zetian abdicates the throne, restoring the Tang dynasty.
dz: 后吴泽甸废除了王位,恢复了唐朝.
de: Empress Wu Zetian abdicates the throne, restoring the Tang dynasty.

t: 霍斯罗二世,萨珊帝国的沙罕沙被推翻.
te: Khosrow II, Shahanshah of the Sasanian Empire, is overthrown.
dz: 霍斯罗二世,萨珊帝国的沙罕沙被推翻.
de: Khosrow II, Shahanshah of the Sasanian Empire, is overthrown.

de: Byzantine emperor Justinian I lays the foundation stone of a new Orthodox Christian basilica in Constantinople – the Hagia Sophia.

t: 罗马皇帝迪奥克莱特安下令摧毁尼可米地的基督教会,从迪奥克莱特尼被迫害的八年起.

dz: 罗马皇帝迪奥克莱特安下令摧毁尼可米地的基督教会,从迪奥克莱特尼被迫害的八年起.
